description: This file contains unit tests for the ResponseCollectorActor class within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically focusing on response collection, timeout handling, and response status evaluation using Akka Actor testing framework.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ResponseCollectorActor, including response collection, timeout handling, and response status evaluation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before each test.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Tests the behavior of ResponseCollectorActor upon timeout with no responses received.

methods.name: allCollected
methods.description: Tests the scenario where all expected responses are received successfully.

methods.name: considersLiveResponseWithNonTimeoutStatusCodeAsNotFailed
methods.description: Verifies that live responses with non-timeout status codes are not marked as failed.

methods.name: considersLiveResponseWithTimeoutStatusCodeAsFailed
methods.description: Verifies that live responses with timeout status codes are marked as failed responses.
